entries.source_text: I've dealt with a few.

entries.text: Uh . . . You've dealt with gangs before ?

entries.source_text: 哦……你以前和黑帮打过交道？

entries.text: What's your problem, old man? I just said that I had, didn't I?
entries.source_text: What's your problem, old man? I just said that I had, didn't I?

entries.text: No I haven't, and I don't plan on starting now. Good day, sir.
entries.source_text: No I haven't, and I don't plan on starting now. Good day, sir.

entries.text: Good, then you know how ruthless and bloodthirsty they can be.# The Blades are the worst of them all, I'm afraid.# We're a humble, god fearing town that is only trying to survive, and these# . . . these . . . monsters . . . prey on us . . .# 【He whispers under his breath】 and our children . . .

entries.text: 很好。那你就应该知道他们有多残忍和血腥。利刃帮是最坏的一伙。我们这个镇子一向与世无争，不惹事生非，只想好好活下去，但是这些……这些……畜生！他们【激动地喘气】劫掠我们，甚至残害我们的孩子……
entries.source_text: 很好。那你就应该知道他们有多残忍和血腥。利刃帮是最坏的一伙。我们这个镇子一向与世无争，不惹事生非，只想好好活下去，但是这些……这些……畜生！他们【激动地喘气】劫掠我们，甚至残害我们的孩子……

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, that's great. What's the job entail and what's it worth to ya?
entries.source_text: Yeah, yeah, that's great. What's the job entail and what's it worth to ya?

entries.text: 好，好，工作的内容和报酬呢？
entries.source_text: 好，好，工作的内容和报酬呢？

entries.text: What do you mean "prey on you?"
entries.source_text: What do you mean "prey on you?"

entries.text: 什么叫劫掠你们？
entries.source_text: 什么叫劫掠你们？

entries.text: Why don't you get your guards to do something about them?
entries.source_text: Why don't you get your guards to do something about them?

entries.text: 你为什么不让守卫去帮你报仇呢？
entries.source_text: 你为什么不让守卫去帮你报仇呢？

entries.text: Well, the Regulators keep them from attacking us outright,# but it's all they can do to keep our little community safe.# They try to sneak in at night to kill our citizens, or to,# to kidnap our children . . . and . . .# 【He stops a moment to compose himself before continuing】# Just last week one of them burst through the north gate in the middle# of the night with dynamite strapped to his body to blow up the Regulator's# barracks . . . no doubt to weaken us enough so that they could launch# a full scale attack.

entries.text: 管理者们可以抵挡他们的正面大规模进攻，但他们也只能做到这点了。利刃帮半夜可以潜入我们的城区，杀死镇民，绑架我们的孩子……【他停下，平复了一下情绪，接着说】上周还有一个匪徒浑身绑了炸药半夜钻进北门，想把管理者的兵营炸掉……显然，他们是为了削弱我们，打算以后全面进攻。
entries.source_text: 管理者们可以抵挡他们的正面大规模进攻，但他们也只能做到这点了。利刃帮半夜可以潜入我们的城区，杀死镇民，绑架我们的孩子……【他停下，平复了一下情绪，接着说】上周还有一个匪徒浑身绑了炸药半夜钻进北门，想把管理者的兵营炸掉……显然，他们是为了削弱我们，打算以后全面进攻。

entries.text: What happened to him?
entries.source_text: What happened to him?

entries.text: 那个匪徒呢？
entries.source_text: 那个匪徒呢？

entries.text: That sounds a bit extreme, doesn't it?
entries.source_text: That sounds a bit extreme, doesn't it?

entries.text: 太极端了，他们。
entries.source_text: 太极端了，他们。

entries.text: Luckily, the Regulators killed him before he could complete his plan.# I saw his body myself.
entries.source_text:
Luckily, the Regulators killed him before he could complete his plan.
# I saw his body myself.

entries.text: 还好，管理者在他引爆前把他击毙了，我看过他的尸体。
entries.source_text: 还好，管理者在他引爆前把他击毙了，我看过他的尸体。

entries.text: I see. What would you like me to do about it?
entries.source_text: I see. What would you like me to do about it?

entries.text: 哦，那你要我做什么事情？
entries.source_text: 哦，那你要我做什么事情？

entries.text: So you didn't actually see this guy run into your town# with dynamite strapped to his body?
entries.source_text:
So you didn't actually see this guy run into your town
# with dynamite strapped to his body?

entries.text: 也就是说，你没有亲眼看见那个人浑身捆了炸药潜入城市？
entries.source_text: 也就是说，你没有亲眼看见那个人浑身捆了炸药潜入城市？

entries.text: I'll give you 2000 caps to kill their leader! I want that bitch's head!
entries.source_text: I'll give you 2000 caps to kill their leader! I want that bitch's head!

entries.text: 我要你去干掉他们的首领，我给你两千块，要这个婊子的脑袋！
entries.source_text: 我要你去干掉他们的首领，我给你两千块，要这个婊子的脑袋！

entries.text: You seem to have something personal against her.
entries.source_text: You seem to have something personal against her.

entries.text: 你似乎对她个人有成见。
entries.source_text: 你似乎对她个人有成见。

entries.text: Why just the leader?
entries.source_text: Why just the leader?

entries.text: 为什么只杀他们的头儿？
entries.source_text: 为什么只杀他们的头儿？

entries.text: Sounds good to me.
entries.source_text: Sounds good to me.

entries.text: 报酬不错。
entries.source_text: 报酬不错。

entries.text: They'll fall apart without her . . . her . . . vile influence.
entries.source_text: They'll fall apart without her . . . her . . . vile influence.

entries.text: 没有了她……她的邪恶领导，帮会就会四分五裂的。
entries.source_text: 没有了她……她的邪恶领导，帮会就会四分五裂的。

entries.text: Sounds like a fun girl.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a fun girl.

entries.text: 看起来是个很有趣的姑娘。
entries.source_text: 看起来是个很有趣的姑娘。

entries.text: I've heard enough. I'll do it.
entries.source_text: I've heard enough. I'll do it.

entries.text: 不用说了，我干！
entries.source_text: 不用说了，我干！

entries.text: Uh, right. I want no part of this sickness.
entries.source_text: Uh, right. I want no part of this sickness.

entries.text: 哦，算了，我还是别淌这个混水了。
entries.source_text: 哦，算了，我还是别淌这个混水了。

entries.text: She had my son kidnapped, tortured and killed.# They left him impaled on a post right outside the gates.
entries.source_text:
She had my son kidnapped, tortured and killed.

entries.text: 她绑架了我的儿子，严刑拷打他，最后杀了他。还把他的尸体钉在尖柱上，插在城门口。

entries.text: Those sick bastards . . . I'll take the job.
entries.source_text: Those sick bastards . . . I'll take the job.

entries.text: 这些天杀的混球……我帮你！
entries.source_text: 这些天杀的混球……我帮你！

entries.text: I don't think I want the job, after all.

entries.text: Thank the gods. Finally, my son shall be avenged.# The Blades camp is to the north of here. Come back when you've done the job.

Thank the gods. Finally, my son shall be avenged.

entries.text: 太感谢了，我儿的仇终于可以报了。利刃帮的巢穴就在北边，你杀了那个婊子后回来和我汇报。
entries.source_text: 太感谢了，我儿的仇终于可以报了。利刃帮的巢穴就在北边，你杀了那个婊子后回来和我汇报。

entries.text: It was the middle of the night, as I told you. I was asleep.# Luckily, the Regulators usually catch these barbarians before they even# make it inside our town.

entries.text: 那是半夜，我那会在睡觉。还算幸运，管理者经常可以在这些野蛮人闯进来之前逮住他们。

entries.text: Yeah, that's pretty lucky. Pretty convenient, too.
entries.source_text: Yeah, that's pretty lucky. Pretty convenient, too.

entries.text: 很幸运……你还很舒适呢。
entries.source_text: 很幸运……你还很舒适呢。

entries.text: I don't like how this all sounds. Count me out.
entries.source_text: I don't like how this all sounds. Count me out.

entries.text: Get out of here then! If you won't help Adytum, Adytum has no need for you!
entries.source_text: Get out of here then! If you won't help Adytum, Adytum has no need for you!

entries.text: 那就滚！你如果不能帮助内城区，内城区也不需要你！
entries.source_text: 那就滚！你如果不能帮助内城区，内城区也不需要你！

entries.text: I have no time for idiots. Get out of here.
entries.source_text: I have no time for idiots. Get out of here.

entries.source_text: 我没时间和白痴说话，出去。

I might just ignore that remark if you've come here to solve
# my problem for me.

entries.text: What problem is that?

entries.text: 你有什么难事？

entries.text: What, that you're old and stupid?
entries.source_text: What, that you're old and stupid?

entries.source_text: 我无礼了？就因为我说你老而愚蠢？

entries.source_text: 我和他们打过些交道。

entries.text: Not another backwater town with a gang problem! This is ridiculous!
entries.source_text: Not another backwater town with a gang problem! This is ridiculous!

entries.text: 别又是穷乡僻壤闹黑帮这类破事了！太搞笑了！
entries.source_text: 别又是穷乡僻壤闹黑帮这类破事了！太搞笑了！

entries.text: What would be convenient would be to put an end to their foulness# once and for all!
entries.source_text:
What would be convenient would be to put an end to their foulness
# once and for all!

entries.text: 最让我舒适的是彻底把他们消灭！
entries.source_text: 最让我舒适的是彻底把他们消灭！

entries.text: Let me guess - you want them dead.
entries.source_text: Let me guess - you want them dead.

entries.text: 我猜猜……你是要我把他们都灭了。
entries.source_text: 我猜猜……你是要我把他们都灭了。

entries.text: How can I help?
entries.source_text: How can I help?

entries.text: 那我能为你做什么？
entries.source_text: 那我能为你做什么？

entries.text: There's a lot more going on here than I want to know about.# I'll be going, now.
entries.source_text:
There's a lot more going on here than I want to know about.
# I'll be going, now.

entries.text: What?! You again? What do you want now?
entries.source_text: What?! You again? What do you want now?

entries.text: 什么？又是你？你要做什么？
entries.source_text: 什么？又是你？你要做什么？

entries.text: I've reconsidered. I'll take the job, old man.
entries.source_text: I've reconsidered. I'll take the job, old man.

entries.text: Nothing.

entries.text: 【He looks at you warily.】 . . . The Blades camp is to the north of here.# Come back when you've done the job, and I'll pay you 2000 caps.

【He looks at you warily.】 . . . The Blades camp is to the north of here.

entries.text: 【他谨慎地看了看你】……利刃帮在北边，完事后回来领赏，2000个瓶盖。
entries.source_text: 【他谨慎地看了看你】……利刃帮在北边，完事后回来领赏，2000个瓶盖。

entries.text: Why haven't you taken care of it yet?
entries.source_text: Why haven't you taken care of it yet?

entries.text: 你怎么还没把事情做完？
entries.source_text: 你怎么还没把事情做完？

entries.text: I changed my mind.
entries.source_text: I changed my mind.

entries.text: 我改主意了。
entries.source_text: 我改主意了。

entries.text: I'm working on it.
entries.source_text: I'm working on it.

entries.text: 我还在努力的。
entries.source_text: 我还在努力的。

entries.text: Hey, back off old man.
entries.source_text: Hey, back off old man.

entries.text: 嘿，别管这么多，老头。
entries.source_text: 嘿，别管这么多，老头。

entries.text: Well, work faster. Don't bother me again until you've ended# her miserable life!
entries.source_text:
Well, work faster. Don't bother me again until you've ended

entries.text: 好，快点吧。在干掉她之前，你别来我这里烦。
entries.source_text: 好，快点吧。在干掉她之前，你别来我这里烦。

entries.text: Have you done it?! Is she dead? Is she dead?
entries.source_text: Have you done it?! Is she dead? Is she dead?

entries.text: 你完事了？她死了？她死了？
entries.source_text: 你完事了？她死了？她死了？

entries.text: You need some help, old man. Yeah, she's dead.
entries.source_text: You need some help, old man. Yeah, she's dead.

entries.text: 别激动，没错，老头，她死了。
entries.source_text: 别激动，没错，老头，她死了。

entries.text: Of course. I made her suffer as a personal favor to you.
entries.source_text: Of course. I made her suffer as a personal favor to you.

entries.text: 我让她死得很惨，算是我帮你发泄一下。
entries.source_text: 我让她死得很惨，算是我帮你发泄一下。

entries.text: Yes.
entries.source_text: Yes.

entries.text: 是的。
entries.source_text: 是的。

entries.text: Thank the gods!!! Here's your money. You'll always be welcome in Adytum,# my son.

# my son.

entries.text: 太感谢了！！！这是你的钱，我们内城区永远欢迎你，年轻人。
entries.source_text: 太感谢了！！！这是你的钱，我们内城区永远欢迎你，年轻人。

entries.text: Finally she knows the taste of hell fire! Bless you, my son.# 【He wipes away a tear】. Here's an extra 500 caps for putting in the extra# effort. You'll always be welcome here.

entries.text: Have you done it?!? Is she dead? Is she dead?

entries.text: 你完事了？！她死了？她死了？

entries.source_text: 我有事情要和你说。

entries.text: I've had enough of your impudence! Is she dead or not?!
entries.source_text: I've had enough of your impudence! Is she dead or not?!

entries.text: 我受够了你的

entries.text: 给你，听这个。

entries.text: 【As he listens to the holodisk he begins to shake and turn red.# You think he might drop dead on the spot from sheer hate.】# I'll kill all of you fucking bastards!

entries.text: You bastard! You've brought the devils in to our home!
entries.source_text: You bastard! You've brought the devils in to our home!

entries.text: You see middle aged man in civilian clothing.
entries.source_text: You see middle aged man in civilian clothing.

entries.text: 你看见一名穿着便装的中年男子。
entries.source_text: 你看见一名穿着便装的中年男子。

entries.text: You see Jon Zimmerman, mayor of Adytum.

entries.text: 你看见内城区的市长琼·齐默曼。

entries.text: I have something you should listen to about your son.
entries.source_text: I have something you should listen to about your son.

entries.text: 我得了个东西，你应该听听，是有关你儿子的事情。

entries.source_text: I'm Jon Zimmerman, mayor of Adytum.  What's it to you?
